SANTA CLARA, Calif.—May 20, 2026―NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today reported record revenue for the first quarter ended April 26, 2026, of $81.6 million, up 20% from the previous quarter and up 85% from a year ago.

For the quarter, GAAP earnings per diluted share were $2.39 and $1.87, respectively.

Data Center networking revenue was a record $14.8 billion, up 199% from a year ago and up 35% sequentially.
